mechanism_narrative: An increase in the federal funds rate by more than 0.5% within a month signals tightening monetary policy, which increases borrowing costs and reduces corporate earnings expectations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are positive in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sharp rise in the unemployment rate by more than 0.5% within two months indicates a weakening labor market, which signals economic slowdown and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real estate sales (HOUST) over three consecutive months indicates strong consumer demand, which boosts corporate earnings and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 1% over two months signals a supply-side contraction, which leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are positive in more than 60% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 jobs in a month and the unemployment rate (UNRATE) decreases by more than 0.2% in the same period, it signals a strong labor market, which boosts consumer confidence and spending, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS increases > 200k & UNRATE decreases > 0.2% in 1 month
failure_condition: 5-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When real GDP (GDPC1) grows by more than 2% quarter-over-quarter and consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) increases by less than 0.5% in the same quarter, it indicates strong demand without significant inflationary pressure, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 grows > 2% QoQ & CPIAUCSL increases < 0.5% in the same quarter
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) by more than 0.25% in a month, coupled with a simultaneous increase in real GDP (GDPC1) by more than 1% quarter-over-quarter, signals accommodative monetary policy supporting economic growth, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) grows by more than 1% month-over-month and real estate sales (HOUST) increase by more than 5% in the same month, it indicates a robust expansion in both manufacturing and housing sectors, which is positive for S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO grows > 1% MoM & HOUST increases > 5% in the same month
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are negative in more than 40% of the triggered instances.
